mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies around the Verona Public Library with temperatures at 39 degrees and the moon is in a waning crescent phase.

The city has announced pavement repairs for November 10 and 11 involving work on Nine Mound Road, Morningside Boulevard, and Mozart Street. Additionally, the Plan Commission will review new development projects, including a site plan for Sub-Zero, at their December 7 meeting.
Today you can enjoy the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, Wisconsin Brewing Company has trivia scheduled for November 11.
During the week of October 18 to October 25, a notable incident occurred on October 25 when officers located a man behind the wheel at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue who was arrested for O W I.
The flavor of the day at Culver's is the crowd-pleasing Really Reese's. The store is currently open until 10:30 PM tonight, so it is a great time to stop by for a treat.
